Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
 stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
 pleased to direct the respondents 3, 4 and 5 not to enter and to take the
 actual physical possession, and not to demolish any constructions situated
 in the petitioner's Exhibit P1, P2 and P3 property during the pendency of
 the Writ Petition.
